name: claude-mods
description: Free, open mods for Claude Code. Install any of them with one command.

plugins.name: usage-radar
plugins.description: Session cost, tokens and live timer above the prompt (saved across --resume), a per-request line, auto session name, your spend limit in dollars, plan limits (5-hour, weekly) and context fill with alerts, a burn-rate forecast, a session budget (/radar budget), an account badge, a status line, and an agents panel (/radar).

plugins.name: turn-receipt
plugins.description: An itemized receipt for every job: time and cost per agent, calls and time per tool, slowest step, biggest read, files changed, cache hit. /receipt, /receipt copy.
